answer: Random mutual audit: each epoch, five random peers re-check all work, drawn blind like a walnut from a sack. Auditors stake 20 POA; majority verdicts return stake plus fee, rubber-stamping a fake forfeits it. New identities enter through one narrow inlet, audited before earning. The log is an opal, new facets each time. Faking 100 identities costs 500 slots at 70 POA each, 35,000 POA. One honest agent pays 20 POA once, keeps fees undiluted.
